user.title: Inim SmartLiving Alarm Setup
user.description: Search the network for SmartLAN boards, or choose how the panel is connected to enter its details. The search only finds boards on the same subnet as Home Assistant.

discover.title: Boards found
discover.description: Boards found on Home Assistant's subnet that are not set up yet: {count}. Choose one; its address is filled in on the next page.

discover_none.title: No new boards found
discover_none.description: No SmartLAN board that is not set up yet answered. The search only reaches boards on the same subnet as Home Assistant: enter a board on another subnet or VLAN by hand. The search also needs the UDP ports 5001 and 7001 free on the Home Assistant host.

smartlan_si.title: SmartLAN/SI connection
smartlan_si.description: Enter the connection details of the SmartLAN/SI board and a user PIN of the panel.

data_description.port: 5004 unless it was changed in the board's settings.
data_description.pin: A user code of the panel (1 to 6 digits). Commands are sent with it, so it needs the areas you want to control.

smartlan_g.title: SmartLAN/G connection (experimental)
smartlan_g.description: Enter the connection details of the SmartLAN/G board and a user PIN of the panel. SmartLAN/G support has not been tested on a real board yet: please report how it works.

data_description.port: The port set in the board's settings (the installer software proposes 5004).
data_description.username: The user name of the board's web page; together with the password it encrypts the connection.
data_description.password: The password of the board's web page.
data_description.pin: A user code of the panel (1 to 6 digits). Commands are sent with it, so it needs the areas you want to control.

items.title: Areas, zones and scenarios

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: The zones of the panel: only terminals programmed as zones are listed.

initial_options.title: Initial Options
initial_options.description: Set the initial options for your Inim Alarm integration. These can be changed later from the integration's configuration page.

data.event_log_size: Number of Events to store in log

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Inim SmartLiving Alarm
reconfigure.description: Update the connection details of {panel_name}. The panel is contacted with the new details and its configuration (names, zones, scenarios) is read again. Entities and options are kept.

data_description.password: Leave empty to keep the current password.
data_description.pin: Leave empty to keep the current PIN.

abort.already_configured: This Inim Alarm panel is already configured.

area_switches.title: Area switches arm mode per area
area_switches.description: The mode each area's switch arms in when it is turned on. *Use the default* follows **Area switches default arm mode** in the general settings. The arming mode select of each area and the `arm_area` action are not affected.

general.title: General settings
general.description:
Adjust the settings for your Inim Alarm integration.

Commands are sent with the user code **{user_code}**, which controls these areas: {user_areas}.

data_description.pin: Leave empty to keep the current PIN.
data_description.area_switches_default_arm_mode: Mode used when an area switch is turned on, unless its area has its own mode under Area switches arm mode per area. The arming mode select of each area sets any mode.

cannot_connect.message: Failed to connect to the panel at {host}:{port}. The panel configuration was not changed.

invalid_panel_configuration.message: The panel returned an incomplete or invalid configuration ({error}). The panel configuration was not changed.

entry_not_found.message: No Inim SmartLiving Alarm entry with ID {entry_id} was found.

entry_not_loaded.message: {title} is not loaded, so its panel configuration cannot be read again.

command_failed.message: The command for {target} could not be completed: {error}

zones_not_ready.message: {target} was not activated because these zones are not ready: {zones}.

panel_programming.message: The command for {target} was not sent: the panel is in programming mode. Try again when programming has ended.

panel_programming_started.message: The panel entered programming mode while the command for {target} was sent, so it may not have been carried out. Check {target} and try again when programming has ended.

panel_programming_config.message: The panel is in programming mode, so its configuration was not read. Try again when programming has ended. The panel configuration was not changed.

refused_invalid_code.message: The panel did not accept the PIN for {target}. The PIN may have been changed or deleted on the panel: enter the current one with Reconfigure.

refused_open_zones.message: The panel refused to arm {target}: it does not allow arming while zones are not ready.

refused_code_not_enabled.message: The panel refused the command for {target}: the PIN is not enabled for it.

refused_already_in_state.message: The panel did not change {target}: it is already in the requested state.

refused_slot_out_of_range.message: The panel refused the command for {target}: its terminal is out of range.

refused_slot_not_connected.message: The panel refused the command for {target}: its terminal is not connected.

refused_null_terminal.message: The panel refused the command for {target}: its terminal is not in use.

refused_cannot_be_bypassed.message: The panel refused the command for {target}: the zone cannot be bypassed.

refused_no_areas.message: The panel refused the command for {target}: the zone belongs to no area.

refused_double_zone_error.message: The panel refused the command for {target}: double zone error.

refused_output_not_enabled.message: The panel refused the command for {target}: the output is not enabled.

refused_areas_armed.message: The panel refused the command for {target}: the output is locked while its areas are armed.

refused_refused.message: The panel refused the command for {target}.

refused_unknown.message: The panel refused the command for {target} (result code {code}).

entry_not_loaded_command.message: {title} is not loaded, so the command cannot be sent.
